en.title: Longest Selectable Non-Decreasing Subarray
en.description:
A and B have equal length; for each position of a contiguous subarray, choose exactly one of A[i] or B[i]. Find the longest length that can form a non-decreasing sequence.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and any ranges or guarantees marked "site-added" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided these limits.
en.input: n (1≤n≤200000), then two lines with arrays A and B, whose elements have absolute value ≤10⁹; the ranges are site-added.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
